1. **Fixed-volume fluctuation remainder and small-field fiber domain (`YangMillsHaarBlocking.lean`):** `haarFullLeadingFluctuationRemainder` defines `R_β(V) := A_β(V) - β I_L(V)`, `haarFullLeadingFluctuationRemainder_vacuum_zero_and_div_beta_tendsto_zero` proves `R_β(V) / β → 0` at every fixed `(L, V)`, and `haarSmallFieldFiberSublevel_partition_pos_measure_and_largeField_damping` proves the open small-field / large-field fiber partition `D_β ⊔ D_β^c`, positive Haar sublevel measure, exponential large-field damping `exp(-β I_L(V)) exp(-β δ)`, and transverse distance control under `HaarSmallFieldCoerciveGaugeSlice` (without claiming a uniform-in-`L` polymer norm). 2. **Interacting blocked fiber integral (`YangMillsRGBridgeObstruction.lean`):** `interactingBlockedFiberWeight` and `interactingBlockedEffectiveAction` integrate `exp(-β_k S_1(U) - K_k(U))` inside `dis.fiberKernel V`, `interactingBlockedFiberWeight_zero_remainder_and_exponential_sandwich` proves the two-sided exponential sandwich for bounded measurable `K_k`, and `interacting_twoStep_dyadic_blocking_semigroup_and_effective_action_identity` proves multiplicative factorization of `exp(-c_k)` and cancellation of the additive vacuum constant in the normalized effective action. 3. **Conditional self-adjoint resolvent bridge on `OSHilbert` (`YangMillsReconstructedGeneratorGap.lean`):** `UnboundedSelfAdjointOSSemigroupBridge`, `unbounded_selfAdjoint_osSemigroup_coercive_and_resolvent_without_spectral_floor`, and `wilsonLimit_unbounded_selfAdjoint_resolvent_bridge` prove domain coercivity and construct the everywhere-defined bounded resolvent `(H_op - E)⁻¹` on `OSHilbert` for `E < m` even when `0 ∈ spectrum ℝ T` forbids a bounded logarithm `log T`.
